title: K-projective quotient models and their compatible derived computations
statement: Let X,A,J,U be as in def-sfb-adic-perfect-reduction-model-complexes, and assume every epimorphism of coefficient-universe set sheaves on the slice evaluates surjectively at its terminal object. Let P be an integer cochain complex with finite projective terms and strict finite bounds a,b. Write T for its actual completed constant derived realization restricted to U, R_n for actual derived reduction, C_n(P) and alpha_n(P) for the ordinary models and balancing maps just defined. Each C_n(P) is K-projective. There exist isomorphisms r_n:R_n(T) -> Q(C_n(P)) such that extend(tau_n)(r_(n+1)) followed by the universal K-flat computation comparison at C_(n+1)(P) and Q(alpha_n(P)) equals the actual derived reduction balancing map at T followed by r_n. This is a statement about one object and its computation counits; it asserts no Hom/cohomology identification.

theorem adicPerfectReductionModels (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (_hU : AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible.{u, v} X U)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A) ℤ)
    (a b : ℤ) (_ha : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (_hb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (_hP : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X i) ∧ Module.Projective A (P.X i)) :
    let R := fun n : ℕ ↦
      (finite (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J n).over U
    let C : (n : ℕ) → Cx (R n) := fun n ↦ adicPerfectQuotientComplex.{u, v} X J U P n
    let R₀ := (completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J).over U
    let ρ : (n : ℕ) → D R₀ ⥤ D (R n) := fun n ↦ adicResidueLocalReduction.{u, v} X J U n
    (∀ n : ℕ, (C n).IsKProjective) ∧
    let T : D R₀ := (adicResidueRestriction
      (completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J) U).obj
        (adicResidueConstantPerfect.{u, v} X J P)
    ∃ r : ∀ n : ℕ, (ρ n).obj T ≅ (Q (R n)).obj (C n),
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        (extend (adicPerfectQuotientScalarStep.{u, v} X J U n)).map (r (n + 1)).hom ≫
            (extendComparison (adicPerfectQuotientScalarStep.{u, v} X J U n)).app
              (C (n + 1)) ≫
            (Q (R n)).map (adicPerfectQuotientStep.{u, v} X J U P n).hom =
          (adicPerfectDerivedQuotientStep.{u, v} X J U n).hom.app T ≫ (r n).hom
